record_title: Sharpness of the nonnegative-parameter range for the ultraspherical lower envelope
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Classical Jacobi/Gegenbauer identities used in the proof are not claimed as new. The originality claim is limited to sharpness of the September 2026 Castillo--Sadigova lower-envelope theorem across the full Jacobi range alpha>-1, the explicit degree-5 first-cell defect for -1/2<alpha<0, and the three-regime failure classification. The original motivating question itself was posed only for alpha>=0. No independent validation is asserted.
